data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent Artemis runs to validate the system's effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Data is sourced from recent Artemis runs
Metrics are presented clearly and accurately
Charts reflect real-world performance

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create various data visualizations such as pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Include at least three types of charts (line, bar, area)
Charts display pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates
Charts are interactive and visually appealing

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to show LLM cost over time, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes line, bar, and area charts
Data updates in real-time or at regular intervals
Charts accurately reflect current metrics

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis, including cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning, using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Charts display cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics
Each feature is clearly explained with visual support
Metrics are accurate and up-to-date

features.title: Demonstrate Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Show TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Metrics are accurate and based on recent data
Chart is easy to interpret

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for data visualization.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Utilize Existing Demo Templates
features.description: Leverage existing demo templates from the specified directory to create the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Templates from /home/bbrelin/src/repos/salesforce/slides/ are used
Incorporate elements from contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html
Maintain consistency with existing demos

features.title: Implement Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with the option for manual navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set time interval
Users can manually navigate between slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Illustrate Supervisor Integration
features.description: Use a pie chart to demonstrate supervisor integration across different stages.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration
Chart is interactive and visually clear
Integration details are easy to understand

features.title: Design Professional Presentation Style
features.description: Apply a professional gradient background and smooth transitions to enhance the presentation's visual appeal.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall design is professional and cohesive
